The tables below are generated from `action.yml` when this site is rendered, so they always describe the version of the action in this repository.

## Inputs

::: {#action-inputs .updater-options}

The inputs table is generated from `action.yml` at render time.

:::

Only `github-token` is required, and it defaults to the token of the running workflow.
An input whose default is `""` is inactive unless set.

## Outputs

::: {#action-outputs .updater-options}

The outputs table is generated from `action.yml` at render time.

:::

Outputs are read through the step identifier, as in [check for updates without creating a pull request](../getting-started/recipes.qmd#check-for-updates-without-creating-a-pull-request).
